key_points: Iran crisis risk premium re-emerging after a period of market complacency, raising geopolitical uncertainty for equities
August CPI came in at 3.4% YoY / 0.4% MoM, signaling sticky inflation ahead of a critical FOMC rate decision next week
A bearish megaphone technical pattern has been identified on SPY, adding to near-term downside risk
The FOMC meeting is the dominant binary catalyst; policy path clarity will likely override other signals in either direction
Despite negative headlines, the S&P 500 broke a four-day losing streak, suggesting the market is not yet capitulating
